name: emberbound
description: Emberbound - TypeScript / React / PixiJS / Capacitor migration spike

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared-types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/game-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/game-content/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:save:web: node --import tsx tools/smoke/save-integration-check.mjs && node --import tsx tools/c3-playtest/flow.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npm run cap:sync -w @emberbound/mobile
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && npm run android:apk -w @emberbound/mobile
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && npm run android:release -w @emberbound/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:purity && npm run check:art && npm run test && npm run parity
